description.text: Computer Science and Technology is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates computer theory, software engineering, hardware design, and information technology. It belongs to the category of computer science in engineering (professional code: 080901), with a four-year duration of study and confers a Bachelor of Engineering degree. This major is based on computational theory and focuses on the design, development and application of computer systems, covering core areas such as algorithm design, software development, hardware architecture and data processing. It is a core supporting discipline for promoting the development of cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, big data and the Internet of Things

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Xi'an Jiaotong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Xi’an Jiaotong University Application form for international students. (Automatically formed after online application in XJTU system);2. Notarized original or translated copies of senior high school graduation diploma, either in Chinese or English; fresh graduates should provide the original expected graduation certificate issued by their school, and supplement the graduation document when registering;3. Transcriptsa) Notarized original or translated copies of high school academic transcripts, including courses taken, scores achieved, and clarification of the scoring system;b)The transcript of the unified standardized examination in the student’s home country or the internationally prevailing standardized examinations (such as A-Level, IBDP, etc.);4. Language certificates such as HSK, TOEFL, IELTS, and Duolingo (applicants whose mother tongue is Chinese/English are free from the above certificate after getting approved from our school);5. A recommendation letter written by the high school headmaster or teachers (email, phone number and signature should be included.)6. Study plan written in English or Chinese with no less than 600 characters or words;7. Scanned copy of valid foreign ordinary passport;8. Physical Examination Record for Foreigner (download at http://sie.xjtu.edu.cn/en/2.pdfand fill in Chinese or English. The applicant must strictly take all the examinations as required by the Form. Forms leaving a blank or absence of suggestion and signature of the doctor or seal of the hospital are invalid. The results are valid for six months.);9. Non-criminal record within the validity period;10. Other supporting documents. (if you have any)

requirements.text: 1. 18-25 years of age & with good health status;2. Valid foreign ordinary passport;3. High school / senior secondary or advanced diploma; (Applicants who are still in the last year of high school can provide the expected graduation certificate for applying while the official diploma must be provided before Sep 1st, 2025 upon enrollment)4. Language skillsChinese taught program: Submit Chinese proficiency certificate. Proficiency must be above HSK 4 or equivalent. (Applicants who do not meet the language requirement are allowed to take foundation courses, and enroll in the degree program after passing the relevant review and exams. Only students who reach HSK 4 could enter major study; information and details for the foundation program can be found on our website:http://sie.xjtu.edu.cn/)English taught program: Submit English proficiency certificate. IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 80, or Duolingo English Test 110 (or above), or other equivalent English proficiency certificates recognized by our university are accepted.ForIndustrial Design (English-taught) Program, applicants need to provide ENGLISH TOLC-I score of at least 30。Native speakers of Chinese or English can be exempted from the corresponding language proficiency certificate after being recognized by our university.5. Comply with the regulations of the Ministry of Education’s document. [2020] No.12 and the relevant regulations of our university.
